episode_summary: In this episode, Chris Wolfe shares his journey from house flipping to becoming a top real estate producer in a new market. He discusses the importance of open houses and cold calling for lead generation, and how he uses a structured daily routine to stay productive. Chris also introduces his accountability tool, Activate Daily, which helps him focus on critical tasks to drive his business forward.
